plaatsen.tekst: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
And God hath ➔ both raised up the Lord, and ➔ will ➔ also raise up us by his own power.
